mapper.select:
SELECT WP.년월 AS W_DEDT , WP.등록구분 AS W_REGISTSE , ROUND(WP.예상중량1,0) AS W_PREDICTWT1 , ROUND(WP.예상중량2,0) AS W_PREDICTWT2 , ROUND(WP.예상중량3,0) AS W_PREDICTWT3 , ROUND(WP.확정중량1,0) AS W_DCSNWT1 , ROUND(WP.확정중량2,0) AS W_DCSNWT2 , ROUND(WP.확정중량3,0) AS W_DCSNWT3 , WP.거래처비고 AS W_NOTE , WP.관리자비고 AS W_ADMINNOTE , WP.단가단위 AS UPC_UNTPCUNIT , (CASE WHEN WP.단가단위 = 3 THEN 'KG' WHEN WP.단가단위 = 2 THEN 'EA' ELSE 'BOX' END) AS W_UNIT_CHRCTR
, RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , (CASE IC.단위중량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위중량 END) AS IC_UNITWT , (CASE IC.단위당수량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위당수량 END) AS IC_UNITQY , (CASE IC.포장단위 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.포장단위 END) AS IC_PACKNGUNIT , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE
ORDER BY WP.년월 , RTRIM(IC.품목명)
mapper.sql: FROM 웹거래처수요예측 WP JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WP.품목코드 = IC.품목코드)

update.foreach:
UPDATE 웹거래처수요예측 SET
확정중량1 = #{item.wDcsnWt1},
확정중량2 = #{item.wDcsnWt2},
확정중량3 = #{item.wDcsnWt3},
거래처비고 = #{item.wNote}, 수정자 = #{bcncCode}, 수정일자 = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112), 수정시간 = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),108),':','') WHERE 년월 = #{item.wDedt} AND 품목코드 = #{item.wCode} AND 거래처코드 = #{bcncCode}
